resolution.question: Will Lucia Ferreyra's two-person nonprofit submit its completed Alder Foundation application before the portal closes at 17:00 on the 30th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the completed application (including the countersigned budget spreadsheet) was successfully submitted to the Alder Foundation portal before 17:00 on 2026-09-30. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
